Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 29.89 per unit (po:4500014436-10, po:4500014383-10, po:4500014337-10).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We acknowledge your data regarding past orders; however, historical pricing does not dictate current terms. 

In response to the increased volume of 23,400 units and the 36-month term, we have adjusted our offer. Our revised price is €31.90 per unit. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot consists of a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your cost model; however, our pricing reflects our specialized manufacturing processes and current operational realities. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

In response to your revised offer, we can adjust our price to €31.60 per unit for the 23,400 volume and 36-month term. This represents a significant concession on our part and reflects our commitment to this partnership.

For our Angebot, we specify a price of €31.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 7 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

decisions.tactician: E0 is the only selectable option; all alternatives have unknown trade values. It meets our volume must-have and offers the long commitment and relaxed lead time this supplier says it prioritises, which makes acceptance more plausible near the current price. Citing the forecast rise, the weak on-time record and our order history anchors the price near €29.89. I left out the should-cost argument: with a margin-health charge in play, pushing toward its cost floor gains us nothing.
